fullDescription: A refined, editorial-style landing page design featuring a minimalist 'SuperExtension' aesthetic. The style blends premium serif typography with modern sans-serif UI elements, utilizing a soft #FBFBFC background, glassmorphism cards, and subtle floating animations. It is ideal for high-end SaaS, browser extensions, productivity tools, or fintech landing pages where trust and elegance are paramount. The layout uses a central hero focus surrounded by a dynamic background of blurred social-proof cards and a 40px grid pattern.
prompt:
## Resumo
An elegant, minimalist landing page design for a digital product, characterized by a sophisticated mix of Gambetta serif and Satoshi sans-serif fonts, a soft light-gray palette, and floating glassmorphism UI elements that create depth through motion and blur.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a background color of #FBFBFC and a subtle radial grid pattern (radial-gradient(circle, #E5E7EB 1px, transparent 1px) with background-size: 40px 40px at 20% opacity). Use 'Gambetta' as the serif font for large headings and decorative text, and 'Satoshi' for body copy and UI elements. Primary text should be #1A1A1A. Implement glassmorphism cards using background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), backdrop-filter: blur(24px), and a 1px border of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4). Decorative elements should include large, low-opacity (0.03) serif text and blurred radial gradients (blue-50 and slate-100) in the background corners. Buttons should have a border-radius of 9999px. Use an animation curve for floating elements that involves translateY(0 to -20px) and slight rotation (2deg) over a 12s duration.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Background Layering
The background consists of three layers: 1) A 40px dot grid pattern at 20% opacity. 2) Two large, blurred radial glow spheres (40% width/height, 120px blur) in the top-left (blue-50) and bottom-right (slate-100). 3) Decorative oversized serif text ('Feed', 'Social') at 8rem size with 0.03 opacity, floating subtly.

### Floating Card Ecosystem
Scatter 5-6 glassmorphism cards of varying sizes (250px to 320px width) across the periphery of the screen. Each card should have a different 'animate-float' delay. Include a mix of card types: some with user avatars and handles (Twitter-style), some with subreddit labels (Reddit-style), and some with just text. Use font sizes ranging from 10px (metadata) to 14px (body text) within cards.

### Hero Section
Centralize the hero content. Start with a status badge: a pill-shaped container (bg-slate-50, border-slate-100) containing a pinging status dot (#64748B) and uppercase 10px tracking-widest text. Below, place an H1 using Gambetta font at 6rem to 8rem size, weight 500. Follow with a max-width 512px paragraph in Satoshi font, text-slate-500, size 1.25rem, leading-relaxed.

### Call to Action Area
Below the hero text, place two buttons. The primary CTA is a black (#1A1A1A) rounded-full button with white text, containing a brand icon and 'Add to Chrome' text. Add a hover state that scales the button to 1.02 and reveals a subtle blue/purple glow gradient behind it. The secondary CTA is a ghost button with slate-600 text and a slate-50 hover background.

### Trust Section
Directly below the CTAs, include a 'User Proof' cluster. Show 3 overlapping 40px circular avatars with 4px white borders, followed by a '+12k' counter in a slate-100 circle. Include sub-text: 'Join over 12,000+ daily active users' using slate-400 with the number highlighted in slate-600 font-semibold.

### Navigation Footer
A minimalist absolute-positioned navigation bar at the bottom. Use 11px font-bold, uppercase text with 0.2em tracking for links like 'Privacy Policy', 'Support', and 'GitHub'. Separate items with 4px wide slate-200 dots. Text color should be slate-400, transitioning to slate-900 on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Floating Glass Card — A semi-transparent card used for testimonials or data snippets.
Container: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px. Interaction: Apply 'animate-float' which is an infinite 12s ease-in-out loop: 0%{translate(0,0) rotate(0)} 33%{translate(10px,-20px) rotate(2deg)} 66%{translate(-15px,10px) rotate(-1deg)} 100%{translate(0,0) rotate(0)}.

### Premium Chrome Button — A high-conversion CTA button with a hidden glow effect.
Base: background #1A1A1A; color #FFFFFF; padding 1rem 2rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; display: flex; items-center; gap: 12px. Hover effect: transform: scale(1.02); background: #000000; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1). Background Glow: An absolute positioned div with -inset-1, bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20, rounded-full, blur-md, opacity-0, switching to opacity-100 on parent hover.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain a very high contrast between the Gambetta serif titles and the Satoshi sans-serif UI elements. MUST NOT: Use solid borders for cards; use semi-transparent white borders only. MUST: Keep floating cards at varied opacities (40% to 70%) to create a sense of Z-index depth. MUST: Ensure the 'ping' animation on the status badge is subtle and not distracting.

Key visual motifs include glassmorphism (24px blur), radial grid backgrounds, and 'floating' cards with staggered CSS animations.
